notes.title: Lucky Island version update v1.1.0
notes.notes:
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/43125245/dec39055a3e6b6dda4673b68ff83edc97ee6ba34.png[/img]
Lucky Island version update
Updated version: v1.1.0

This update focuses on improving the dispatch mode of island residents, solving the original idle phenomenon and unpredictable work sequence, and has made significant improvements.

1. Optimize the AI ​​of island residents
Improved resident work patterns: All islanders will now be more engaged in work and the workload will be more evenly distributed. Those residents who have previously worked less often will be given priority to ensure that no resident is idle.
Prioritize the shortest path: The work sequence will be optimized based on the length of the path that islanders take to reach the work location. The islander with the shortest path will start working first, improving overall work efficiency.
2. Adjust the probability of treasure chests
Adjusted the proportion of treasures: Modified the types of treasures obtained from treasure chests, increased the appearance probability of functional buildings, and relatively reduced the frequency of decorative buildings, making it easier for players to obtain practical resources.
3. Fine-tune game details
Fixed errors and prompts: Fixed some error descriptions in the game, and color-coded game prompts to enable players to understand and operate more intuitively.
This update aims to improve the overall game experience and make the world of Lucky Island more interesting and challenging. I hope you all enjoy the changes brought about by this update!

notes.title: The pixel-style management game "Lucky Island" early access release.
notes.notes:
The independently developed and charming pixel-style island management game, "Lucky Island," has officially launched in early access. Let's embark on the journey of building your dream island!

Following the exposure to the STEAM New Product Festival and the Bahamut 2023 ACG Creation Competition, I want to express gratitude to the numerous players who participated in the STEAM New Product Festival, tried out Lucky Island, and provided valuable suggestions. Additionally, thank you for the recognition received in the Bahamut 2023 ACG Creation Competition, which has significantly contributed to the smooth development of Lucky Island. Responding to player feedback, Lucky Island has undergone various adjustments and is set to launch in early access in November 2023. This release aims to engage with players during the ongoing content development, with the early access period anticipated to last approximately six months. As we progressively introduce more game content, we look forward to receiving continuous feedback from players, shaping Lucky Island into an even more perfect gaming experience. The demo version has also been released to allow a broader audience to explore the captivating charm of Lucky Island.

Early Access Version Content:
Latest Version: v0.3 First Island
Version Overview:
The initial version of the game is available in early access, offering players a one-month island time challenge. This allows a comprehensive experience of Lucky Island's unique features. The playable content includes:

Slot machine mode island management
Rich selection of slot machine decks
Free island design
Variable skills with different effects
Rogue style trigger events

Players can indulge in the distinctive gameplay of Lucky Island, anticipating ongoing production of additional game content. We remain open to player feedback, adjusting the game's direction and balance accordingly. Plans for content additions before the official version release are already in progress, and detailed information will be progressively unveiled.
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/43125245/f352f0f4e2970470fd7b56da266ba76d353f2717.png[/img]

Follow-up Content in the Early Access Version:

Complete the first round of island management

New Game Plus Of Lucky Island
Special mode

notes.title: Lucky Island Demo Game Update - Building Mode
notes.notes:
Hello everyone,

It has been a week since the release of the Lucky Island demo, and we would like to express our gratitude for your support. We have received valuable feedback from many players, which has allowed us to address various issues and incorporate fantastic suggestions for the future development of Lucky Island.

In our latest update, we are excited to introduce the Building Mode in the demo version, providing players with more opportunities to experience the joy of constructing on Lucky Island.

Here are the key updates in the latest version:

1. Building Movement Feature: You can now freely adjust the position of buildings on the island during the night.
2. News Board Icon Update: The buttons for receiving various quests on the news board have been updated to differentiate between daytime, when quests are available, and nighttime, when they are not.
3. Building Mode (Demo): This mode allows unrestricted construction during the night, regardless of resource limitations. During the day, you can relax and enjoy observing the automated actions of island residents in this leisurely building mode.
4. Card Acquisition Flow Adjustment: We have removed lengthy card acquisition animations to improve gameplay smoothness.
5. Event Trigger Conflict Handling: Several improvements have been made to address game issues arising from the simultaneous triggering of events, quests, slot machines, and the transition to nighttime.

We would like to highlight one important point that has not been explicitly mentioned in the game: for those who need it, please note that the Enter key can activate the slot machine.

Demo Game Introduction:
Allow me to provide a brief overview of the Lucky Island demo game content. The demo version offers players an 8-day game experience, lasting approximately 30-40 minutes. It includes the first stage of island development, with all basic island functionalities fully accessible. However, there are some limitations on the number of triggered events and news board quests. Additionally, the demo version includes the Building Mode for players to enjoy. Please note that the demo does not offer a save function, but the different choices and paths in the game provide unique enjoyment. We will continue to release more activities and updates related to Lucky Island, so stay tuned for further information.

Thank you for your interest in Lucky Island, and we hope you enjoy the demo!

Just L Studio
